# Liberation Sans sources

PDF.js 6.3.289 bundles unmodified Liberation Sans 1.07.4 TrueType fonts.
They use GPL v2 with the Liberation font exception, not the OFL used by newer
Liberation releases. See the upstream license emitted in
`licenses/pdfjs/standard_fonts/LICENSE_LIBERATION`.

The complete, unmodified 1.07.4 source archive is included here and copied to
`licenses/pdfjs/liberation/` in every build, alongside the license, so recipients
receive the editable SFD font sources, FontForge build scripts and notices.
No font or rendering changes were made.

- PDF.js provenance: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/blob/v6.3.289/external/standard_fonts/README.md
- Upstream project: https://github.com/liberationfonts/liberation-1.7-fonts
- Archive mirror: https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/f/fonts-liberation/fonts-liberation_1.07.4.orig.tar.gz
- SHA-256: `ad98b7498dc2992f7f0868f79b65ce4a720a3acdb63ab3f1f1cb6881117a5406`

The source archive contains the upstream `License.txt`, `COPYING`, `AUTHORS`,
`README` and `Makefile`. Preserve these files and the archive when distributing
Pageborne builds that include these fonts.
